title: Osmium and cadmium implants in the M-types
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Osmium and cadmium implants in the M-types, about over 1,000 years ago at Nazca, Peru, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: These metal implants contain osmium and cadmium, which are extremely rare earth metals.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a set of small three-fingered bodies said to come from Nazca, Peru, and said to be more than a thousand years old. He says that some of them, a group called the M-types, carry metal implants containing osmium and cadmium, which he calls extremely rare metals. If that held up, it would suggest these bodies were worked on with materials and skills nobody expects from that time.
